title: Constructing Two Increasing Arrays
summary: Replace zeros in two binary arrays with positive even integers and ones with positive odd integers. Both resulting arrays must be strictly increasing, and no integer may occur more than once across both arrays combined. Minimize the largest assigned integer and return it.
